messages:
maria: Dropping a quick idea 0min: what if the cost card surfaces an explicit 'cache amortization window' dropdown (1m/5m/15m/1h) so teams can see sensitivity? Simple default 5m.
noah: Love it. We should log selection -> econ.ui.cache_window.selected. Also surface an explanation: 'Cache hits within window share prefetch savings proportionally.'
sophia: FYI for infra: if we make this per-tenant configurable, pressure on metrics cardinality will spike. Can we keep selection UI client-side and only emit the selection event (not every tick)?
infra-bot: infra-bot: note: metric cardinality alert will trigger if tenant-configured cache_window values exceed 50k unique combos. Recommend allow per-tenant list limited to [1m,5m,15m,1h] pre-approved.
maria: That matches PM constraints. Also: how do we display 'savings' vs 'attributed cost'? I propose two small micro-rows: 'Raw token cost' and 'After cache amortization (attributed)'.
noah: For the math, we should show how prefetch credits are split: prefetch_credit * (invocation_token_cost / sum_tokens_in_window). Put link to doc with worked example.
sophia: Implementation: realtime panel calls econ-service/realtime?window=5m&approx=true. The service responds with: total_tokens, prefetch_credits, attributed_costs, cache_hit_rate. We'll keep exact nightly job for historical.
product-bot: product-bot: new experiment created: econ_cache_window_ab_test. Phase 1: 5% internal users.
maria: I'll prototype UI with default 5m, and a compact "why this changed" banner for rollout. Can someone add the metric names and schema to the infra repo?
noah: I'll open the RFC for metric names: econ.attribution.prefetch_credits_v1, econ.attribution.window_tokens_v1, econ.ui.cache_window.selected_v1.
sophia: Ping me when RFC ready. Also add a guard in service: if window > 1h return 400 in realtime to avoid heavy scans.
infra-bot: infra-bot: staging infra quotas updated.
maria: Thanks all. Quick poll: are we comfortable rolling to 5% internal first?
noah: yes
sophia: yes
_meta: cache amortization window ui + infra notes
